TalentLMS Pricing

Free, $119 Core, $229 Grow, $449 Pro per month on annual billing, plus a quote-only Enterprise tier from 1,000 users.

The published prices

Free covers 5 users, 10 courses, no time limit. Core $119/month covers up to 40 users. Grow $229/month covers up to 70 users. Pro $449/month (marked popular) covers up to 100 users. Enterprise is custom pricing, with flexible plans from 500 users and Enterprise proper from 1,000. All paid prices are annual billing (20 percent discount versus monthly).

What to know

Tier-locked, not per-user

  • TalentLMS pricing is locked to user-count brackets, not per-seat. The effective per-user cost falls inside each tier as you approach the cap (Core at 40 users = $2.98/user/month; at 10 users = $11.90/user/month).
  • The count is based on the monthly users who log in, not every registered account, and soft limits mean logins are not blocked once the cap is reached. A Flex add-on lets you register unlimited users and bills purely on the distinct users who log in each month.
  • The 20 percent annual discount is the headline price. Monthly billing is available without the discount.
  • Pro bills $6 per additional user above its 100-user cap. Beyond the published tier ladder, customers move to an Enterprise quote.
  • Enterprise pricing is not published. Flexible plans begin around 500 users; the Enterprise tier proper around 1,000.
